review_type: independent static source review with stdlib-only API reproductions
summary: Two conditional P2 public API correctness issues; planned absolute paths and explicit CUDA avoid both triggers.

findings.title: Relative checkpoint paths do not round-trip through the reader
findings.trigger: run_reference accepts a relative output path from a working directory other than ROOT.parent
findings.effect: Descriptor records a caller-relative path, but pool_conventional resolves it against ROOT.parent and fails to reopen the selected checkpoint.
findings.evidence: Stdlib fixture produced FileNotFoundError; the same file with an absolute descriptor verified.
findings.fix: Resolve output/checkpoint paths before recording them, or use one consistent phase-relative encoding; verify the descriptor round-trip from a different working directory.
findings.planned_root_call_effect: Avoided by the root's explicit absolute output paths.

findings.title: Accepted MPS devices have no checkpointed RNG stream
findings.trigger: A caller selects device='mps', which the inherited resolver accepts
findings.effect: CPU state is restored but the MPS dropout stream is omitted, violating full selected-device restoration and next-update replay on that accepted backend.
findings.evidence: Stdlib API stub confirmed accepted MPS provenance, no MPS state in the snapshot, and an unchanged advanced MPS stream after restore.
findings.fix: Add a reference-side CPU/CUDA device guard, or bind complete RNG capture/restore helpers for each admitted backend and verify replay there.
findings.planned_root_call_effect: Avoided by explicit CUDA; actual CUDA/full-shape numerical qualification remains separate.

static_checks_without_additional_finding: native CE + 0.5 equal CE + 0.5 different CE; immediate backward per weighted pass and one Adam step
all official TRAIN IDs/labels enter every loss; validation labels enter selection/reporting only
fixed view custody, block/member seeds and native construction/device-reset order
200 local + 2500 global actual updates; selected-local model/Adam handoff retaining live RNG
one strict native correct-count selector spanning both stages, update1 first candidate, earliest ties
complete model/Adam/modes/gradients and final selected local/global restoration for CPU/CUDA
four independently selected fixed members, arithmetic class-probability pooling, exact member0 alias

boundaries.root_reported_small_CPU_suite_pass: Context only; receipt not inspected by this reviewer; no CUDA/full-shape conclusion.
